key_insight: An integrated AI fiber-orientation tool reduces preparation time for crash CAE from 25 hours to 0.1 hours—a 99.6% reduction.
engineering_relevance: Crash CAE engineers can prepare orientation fields without molding-specialist support, improving fracture and peak-force predictions over an isotropic baseline.
method: Support injection-gate setting when gate information is unknown.
Voxelize parts and infer fiber orientation with a surrogate model.
Automatically map predictions to crash CAE models and generate reports through one GUI.
evidence_signal: Validation progressed from 2D plates to production parts against a predefined angular-error criterion; component-level testing reduced absolute peak-force error from 19.0% to 11.4% and confined predicted fracture to the test-observed region.
watch_item: Deployment remains initial and limited to directed fracture-prediction scenarios; gate estimation and transfer to other applications require careful validation.
paper_title: From AI Surrogate to Engineering Tool: Toward Production Use of Fiber-Orientation Prediction in Crash CAE
